release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.53 closes key pre-launch commerce and diagnostics gaps. Authenticated Whop membership activations for explicitly mapped plans can now provision Tachyon access automatically from Whop's delivered license key without persisting the plaintext key, while membership identity remains isolated for customers with multiple memberships. Webhook acknowledgement now fails closed when updated entitlement/evidence state cannot be persisted. A privacy-safe Founders Lifetime inventory endpoint provides real cap/sold/remaining state for the public website while finite Whop plan stock remains the checkout enforcement layer. Task status JSON now includes backward-compatible normalized failure metadata for network, proxy, account-authentication, out-of-stock, manual-verification, payment-decline, browser-session and generic runtime conditions. Commercial-launch CI contracts protect these guarantees. This release also exercises Tachyon's new protected-main-safe publication path, provenance-bound public manifest, external Windows-byte verification, runtime health smoke test and guarded manifest rollback introduced by the launch-hardening work. Pre-launch Stable remains intentionally allowed unsigned until the commercial signing gate is enabled.
